headlines.title: Deloitte helped in falsifying documents to evade tax on Abramovich’s wealth
headlines.description: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, BBC finds.

headlines.title: Rejecting closer EU ties would be dereliction of duty, PM to say
headlines.description: Addressing the Commons, Burnham is expected to say that a new deal with the EU could help tackle illegal immigration and boost economic growth.

headlines.title: Iran war threatens Healey's Budget plans, think tank warns
headlines.description: The impact of the Iran war poses significant risks for the government’s spending plans, the Institute for Fiscal Studies says.

headlines.title: AI is less regulated than milk, says Microsoft president
headlines.description: Brad Smith calls for global rules on AI, and says the UK is in the "best position" to lead the charge.

headlines.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
headlines.description: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".
